title: Gravity overview
text: Gravity is an attractive force between objects with mass. It explains why dropped objects fall toward Earth and why planets orbit the Sun. A simple explanation connects the concept to everyday examples and basic physical reasoning.

title: Math reasoning example
text: Question: Why is the sum of two even numbers even? Answer: Each even number can be written as two times an integer. Adding them gives two times the sum of those integers, so the result is also even.
